scope.receiptRegistry: The reports receipt page wraps the existing shared registry in compact mode. It reuses the commerce monetary-flow evidence; it is not a new receipt accounting implementation.

appearance: Report metrics use neutral card surfaces, a light blue accent tint/border and flatter hover states. Existing values, notes, button actions, widths, grid placement and padding are retained; corner radius now matches the shared card scale.

Export request/history headers, selection cards and mobile job cards use full shared border and card tokens with flatter selection shadows. Field/action order, card counts and desktop/mobile composition are retained.
English reporting source filter is labelled Sales source, distinct from the in-store/online Sales channel filter. Query values and filter semantics are unchanged.

explicitInteractionChanges.behavior: Hub, sales/online analytics, exports and period close show a translated QueryErrorState with a retry targeting the failed stores query. Export store-loading failure is no longer labelled as genuinely no stores. Valid empty store state is retained.

Report scope explains denied analytics access instead of leaving an empty body. Export and period-close forms match the existing ADMIN/MANAGER server procedures; STAFF and CASHIER see forbidden feedback and their private queries/actions remain disabled. No server permission was added or removed.

Customer selection and category/register/employee options have independent error/retry controls. Failed or disabled customer queries do not display stale cached results as a successful empty/customer list; customer picker is disabled until its existing report scope is enabled. Selection, search, pagination and clear semantics are unchanged.
Explicit UTC Date reconstruction fixes timezone-less JSON report rows in the page and export path; no monetary or period computation change.

limits: This is an in_review family checkpoint, not complete acceptance of every report/control/state or the overall redesign. Twenty-six route sources plus shared-component and final cross-family acceptance remain.

No real period was closed, export retry job posted, historical cost backfill performed, physical print triggered or external provider contacted in the browser run. The isolated DB suite covers period-close and background export generation.
Query-failure recovery was exercised by rendered-page unit tests, not by injecting an outage into the live QA browser. Every plan/currency/access permutation is not claimed.
Remaining report acceptance includes the full locale/copy matrix, native file download verification and broader successful external/printing states where applicable.
Only the eleven business models named in reports-business-before/after.json were hashed; user/session preferences necessarily changed during role/theme tests and were restored.
Local screenshots/logs are kept in the ignored artifacts folder; tracked documents reference them but do not embed them in Git.
delivery: Local codex/playground only. No main merge/push, schema migration or production deployment.
